subject: Regional Data Residency Jigsaw — architecture deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmepayments.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: arch-team@acmepayments.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Request: multi-region residency deep-dive (EU/US/APAC)

Hi Camila,

We'd like to set up a technical deep-dive to align on multi-region data residency for an upcoming global rollout. Goal is to validate architecture patterns for EU data-at-rest controls, US regional failover, and APAC latency/placement options. Our compliance/privacy leads will attend and may have SOC2/data-retention questions.

Can you do a 60-90 minute session the week of Nov 8–12? Timezone constraints: we prefer late-morning CET or early PST so our engineering and compliance teams can join. If helpful, we can split into two shorter sessions (architecture + procurement/security).

Attendees from our side: myself (Samira Khan), Matthew Lee (security), and an architecture working group (arch-team@acmepayments.com). Please let us know what pre-read you'd like and any ideal attendee list from Redwood.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Cloud Integrations, Acme Payments
From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmepayments.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency deep-dive (EU/US/APAC)

Hi Samira — great to hear from you, thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely run a 75-minute architecture review that covers: (1) residency and data flows by region, (2) deployment patterns (hosted / dedicated / private), (3) failover and routing policies, and (4) compliance evidence and optional on-prem patterns.

Proposed slots (all durations 75 mins):
- Tue Nov 9, 08:00 PT (16:00 CET)
- Wed Nov 10, 17:00 PT (01:00 CET Thu) — later in CET, if that helps APAC

Please confirm which slot works best and who from your team will present compliance items. Who should we include from Redwood? I suggest: Ben Carter (sales lead), Karthik Iyer (platform engineering), Marissa Cole (solutions architect). Ben — can you join the call and own the commercial context? Karthik/Marissa — we'll need a short run-of-show and 10–15 minute technical demo of routing/caching.

Pre-read we can share: short deck + regional arch diagram. If you have a traffic profile (TPS, typical seq lengths), send that over — it helps us size dedicated vs hosted options.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2027 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency deep-dive (EU/US/APAC)

I'll be on this. Quick notes:
- I'll own commercial context and where the deal currently sits (early-stage POC -> potential Dedicated contract).
- Recommend we include Karthik for the runtime/quantization tradeoffs and Marissa for migration/playbook.
- Request from my side: prepare a short slide showing cost/latency tradeoffs for the three deployment modes and a couple of anecdotal benchmarks (warm vs cold cache).

Agree 75 minutes sounds right. Camila, can you capture the run-of-show and share the agenda PDF when you send the invite?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmepayments.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: arch-team@acmepayments.com, Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@acmepayments.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 13:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency deep-dive (EU/US/APAC)

Thanks Camila — Tue Nov 9, 08:00 PT (16:00 CET) works for us.

A few requests before the call:
- Please include an agenda with timeboxed topics (so privacy can plan questions).
- We need coverage for: data-at-rest encryption verification, audit logs & retention, and architecture for cross-border requests.
- Our privacy lead Matthew will bring a short list of must-have controls; can Redwood prepare a short summary of KMS/HSM options and audit log retention policies?
- Also can you confirm whether the dedicated deployment supports EU-only residency without US fallback by default (we may need an air-gapped/private option).

If you could share a draft agenda and an architecture diagram ahead of time, that would be really helpful.

Best,
Samira
